about: Duel rules applied in the melee-hit hook. Checked top to bottom; first match wins.

rows.when: the player is not one of the two fighters, or either fighter is not a duelist (no melee weapon in right hand)
rows.notes: NPC-vs-NPC fights, creatures, unarmed, bows and magic keep vanilla Skyrim behaviour
Matching guard deflects the attack: no damage, attacker recoils
Anything not blocked (wrong guard, or victim mid-attack) lands with normal Skyrim damage
